name: asp-classic-tools
description: Go-to-definition and include tree for ASP Classic (VBScript) projects.

aspClassicTools.eagerIndex.description: Scan and parse every .asp file in the workspace on startup. Off by default: files are parsed on demand as you open or save them (plus whatever they include), so large workspaces on a slow or remote drive start instantly. Turn on for full workspace coverage from the start if your workspace is small enough to scan quickly.

aspClassicTools.workspaceFallback.description: When Go to Definition finds nothing in the current file or its include graph, fall back to searching every file currently indexed. With eagerIndex off, that's whatever's been opened/saved so far, not necessarily the whole workspace.

aspClassicTools.webRoot.description: Filesystem path that virtual="..." includes resolve against. Leave empty to keep virtual includes unresolved.
